summary: Tested density changes (2x) and IST timezone conversion for Trinity help desk. All features working correctly: compact ticket list rows (~51-52px), reduced conversation padding (px-2 py-1, space-y-0.5), 12px font size for messages, and all timestamps displaying in IST (Asia/Kolkata) format.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Density and timezone changes are complete. Ticket list uses py-1.5 padding with 2-row layout (title + combined preview/metadata). Conversation uses space-y-0.5 p-1.5 container, px-2 py-1 message padding, text-[12px] leading-snug for content. All timestamps use ensureUTC() + timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' for IST display.

features_tested.details: 50 visible tickets in 1024px container (~4.9 tickets/100px). Row heights 51-52px with compact 2-row layout: title row + combined preview/metadata row. Uses py-1.5 padding per TicketsListView.js.
Container uses p-1.5 space-y-0.5 per TicketConversation.js line 264. Messages have px-2 py-1 padding per EmailMessage.js. Message body uses text-[12px] leading-snug per EmailMessage.js line 266.
All ticket list timestamps display in IST format 'Feb 23, 3:27 PM'. formatTimeAgo in TicketsListView.js correctly uses timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata'.
Message timestamps display in IST. formatDate in EmailMessage.js appends 'Z' to naive UTC timestamps and uses timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata'.
Created field in ticket details panel shows IST time (e.g., 'Feb 23, 3:27 PM'). Uses dateFormat.js ensureUTC() + APP_TIMEZONE constant.
Avatars unchanged at 24x24px. Initials display correctly (e.g., 'TT' for TNTTravelCentral). No layout conflicts with density changes.
No overlapping elements detected. Ticket list, conversation view, and details panel render correctly with compact styling.

timezone_verification.ensureUTC_function: Appends 'Z' to naive UTC timestamps before Date parsing

TicketsListView.js - py-1.5 row padding, formatTimeAgo IST
